name: Archaeornithura
sum: Hauterivian hongshanornithid from the Huajiying Formation of Hebei, the oldest known ornithuromorph.
holotype: STM7-145, with the paratype STM7-163, from shales of the Huajiying Formation.
biology: Its long legs suggest it waded; it already had fairly advanced plumage.
author: Wang et al. 2015
